texts.value: Component of the CCR4-NOT complex, a large multiprotein complex with several proteins assembled around the scaffolding protein CNOT1 (PubMed:29593045, PubMed:31180491). This complex is one of the major cellular mRNA deadenylase and is linked to various cellular processes including bulk mRNA degradation, miRNA-mediated repression, translational repression during translational initiation and general transcription regulation. CNOT12 affects helicase selection into the CCR4-NOT complex (PubMed:29593045, PubMed:31180491). In addition, plays a role in DNA double strand break repair and is involved in actin cytoskeleton rearrangement and cancer cell invasion (PubMed:25749521, PubMed:28202517)
Component of the CCR4-NOT complex (PubMed:29593045, PubMed:31180491). Binds to the ANK repeat domain of TNKS1 and TNKS2 (PubMed:11854288)
Colocalizes with chromosomes during mitosis, and in the cytoplasm with cortical actin
Detected in testis, ovary, lung, skeletal muscle, heart, prostate and pancreas, and at very low levels in brain and peripheral blood leukocytes

The levels of CNOT12 is reduced during certain adenovirus serotypes infection, favoring the production of viral DNA during infection (PubMed:29593045). Up-regulated by ionizing radiation (IR) (PubMed:25749521)
Highly phosphorylated by ATM or ATR in response to ionizing radiation-induced DNA damage
